scope: Shared guard-core policy modules plus docs/evidence for phases 2 through 12
implementedControls: Runtime capability discovery and effective-risk summary
File operation firewall for normalized path, realpath escape, hidden path, protected path, mass change, and secret-bearing content decisions
Network egress policy for URL parsing, private/link-local/cloud metadata blocking, redirect-chain checks, allowed hosts, and secret payload detection
MCP gateway pre-invocation policy with server inventory, permission allowlist, prompt-injection handling, taint escalation, and argument redaction
Taint engine for prompt-injection and untrusted-source influence on high-risk actions
Transaction preview and in-memory checkpoint metadata with redacted previews
Enterprise policy-change validation for signed policy downgrade, mandatory control removal, disabled controls, expired exceptions, and admin-only enterprise changes
Authenticated local broker preflight endpoints for runtime capabilities, file operations, network egress, MCP tools, and policy changes
Raw terminal open warning and runtime coverage status item in the VS Code extension
Dependency overrides for adm-zip, sharp, and fast-uri to clear known high-severity npm advisories
Process sandbox preflight policy with deny-before-launch shell/env-secret checks and constrained sandbox profiles
Extension isolation preflight policy with enterprise allowlist/block recommendations for risky third-party AI extensions
Security 100 evidence gate requiring 99+ foundation, OS enforcement, enterprise extension control, signed provenance, and recovery drill evidence

coverageByPhase.phase4FileChangeFirewall: STRONG_ENFORCEMENT for callers routed through FileOperationFirewall
coverageByPhase.phase5TerminalFirewall: STRONG_ENFORCEMENT for broker-controlled allowlisted commands; DETECTION_ONLY for manual/raw terminal review
coverageByPhase.phase7NetworkEgress: STRONG_ENFORCEMENT for routed requests; UNSUPPORTED for arbitrary process egress
coverageByPhase.phase8MCPGateway: STRONG_ENFORCEMENT for gateway-routed invocations; PARTIAL_VISIBILITY for config scanning
coverageByPhase.phase9Taint: STRONG_ENFORCEMENT for callers that pass source provenance into policy
coverageByPhase.phase10Rollback: PARTIAL_VISIBILITY for preview/checkpoint metadata; rollback execution not universally wired
coverageByPhase.phase11Governance: STRONG_ENFORCEMENT for policy changes routed through GovernancePolicy
coverageByPhase.phase12RedTeamReadiness: PARTIAL_VISIBILITY with internal tests; external validation still required

remainingUnsupported: Universal interception of third-party VS Code extensions
Raw terminal and external shell enforcement
